text:
Praveen: Heads up — seeing a 3x spike in 503s for the v2 API from iOS SDK 2.1.2 clients starting ~03:40 UTC. Canary was moved from 10% -> 50% earlier and errors trended up. Can we pause the rollout and pin mobile traffic to v1?

deploy-bot: Deployment event detected: v2 canary -> 50% (r-5591). Started 1719001200. Target route: mobile-canary. Current health: error-rate increased @1719001228.

Maya: Thanks — pausing now. @deploy-bot can you stop traffic shift and set canary to 0% for mobile-canary? Also add a hotpatch label.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Executing: `deploy bot pause --release r-5591 --route mobile-canary`

Sara: Looking at gateway logs — seeing `Header: X-Client-Version` values inconsistent for iOS 2.1.2 (sometimes blank). That correlates with our routing rule that prefers `X-Client-Version: v2` for canary. If header missing we fall through to v2 and the downstream service rejects requests -> 503.

Alex: Customer success seeing a handful of escalations from enterprise customers on 2.1.x. They expect no functional change. We should pin them quickly.

Maya: Plan: 1) Pause canary for mobile traffic (done). 2) Create temporary routing fallback: treat missing `X-Client-Version` as v1 for mobile UA. 3) Roll back any model/handler changes applied to v2 for 2.1.* clients if needed. 4) Post note in release notes and notify CS. Thoughts?

Sara: Agree. I can push a gateway rule to coerce missing header -> v1 for UA matching `iPhone` and `SDK/2.1`. Quick patch:

```json
{
  "match": {
    "user_agent": "iPhone",
    "sdk_version": "2.1.*",
    "x_client_version": ""    
  },
  "action": {
    "set_header": {"X-Client-Version": "v1"}
  }
}
```

Sara: I'll apply to the edge for the EU/NA regions. It should be low-risk and reversible.

Praveen: Good. Also let's pin tenant-level signals: add mobile client header pin for known enterprise orgs (acme-inc, bright-start). We need to avoid routing them to v2 until SDK patch is out.

Maya: ops-bot, add tenant pins for `acme-inc,bright-start` to the exclude list for r-5591.

ops-bot: Command received: `ops-bot pin-tenants --release r-5591 --tenants acme-inc,bright-start --exclude` -> completed.

Alex: I'll message the CS triage channel and notify the affected accounts that we're pausing the rollout and working on a fix.

Maya: For rollback decision: priority is minimizing customer impact. If gateway header coercion is insufficient we will do a safe rollback of the v2 handler for mobile route. Rollback command (if needed): `deploy bot rollback --release r-5591 --to r-5589 --grace 2m`

Praveen: Also add a short blurb to the release notes under "Known issues" explaining SDK 2.1.2 header behavior and that mobile customers are pinned to v1 until client/SDK fix is rolled out. Maya, can you draft the note?

Maya: Drafting now. Will push to the release-notes repo and tag the release with `paused-mobile-canary-1719001234`.

Sara: Patch applied to edge (EU/NA). Early indicators: error-rate for mobile-canary dropping. I'll monitor for 15m and report back.

Maya: Thanks. Ops: leave deploy monitoring on and hold any further v2 shifts. We'll regroup in 20. :thumbsup:

Alex: Notifying customers now. ETA 5m.

Sara: 15m check-in: error-rate back to baseline for mobile-canary. No new 503 spikes observed.

Praveen: Reconfirming: keep tenant pins in place until SDK 2.1.3 ships with header normalization. Do we need a hotpatch to the SDK instead of gateway coercion? Engineering should coordinate with SDK team in parallel.

Maya: Agreed. Sara to keep edge rule for now; SDK team to prepare a 2.1.3 patch. I'll update the release notes and CS message once SDK ETA is confirmed.

deploy-bot: Summary: v2 canary paused for mobile; tenant exclusions applied for acme-inc, bright-start; gateway header coercion applied to EU/NA. Incident tag: #mobile-v2-503-1719001234.

Praveen: Closing loop — thanks everyone. Follow-up: SDK team to post status by EOD.
